_about: Offline verdicts per question x model for the admin model comparison (PAR-855). Seeded from the approved mockup's matrix, whose notes summarise ml-bench PR #445 (full period), #447 (driver_level, H5 + TFT level) and #450 (Chronos-2). state: better|worse|unclear|pending, always against what is served today for that question. diff/ciLow/ciHigh only where the run reported them against that reference; never filled in otherwise. expectedBy only for runs still in progress. note: one German sentence, shown when live data does not decide the cell. servedNotes: the note of each question's served (today) cell. 2026-10-11: the Chronos cells come from the mixed-weekday re-run of #450 (--shard 0/5, 47 origins over all seven weekdays; the earlier --shard 0/7 run put every origin on a Thursday, which locked every lead to one target weekday). Toto/TiRex are still pending. 2026-10-11 (PAR-855 follow-up): live_h0_1 x chronos is pending (offline worse only at 15 min, better at 30 and 60 min); notes that quoted the headline window or a lead outside the question as the full period were corrected, plan_d6_60 x tfth5 was judged against wt_med instead of served (now unclear), and the plan_d0_1 x tfth5 diff was against wt_med, not served (removed).

persist.note: In der ersten Stunde praktisch dasselbe wie PCN. Auf 15 Minuten nicht zu schlagen, ab 30 Minuten ist Chronos-2 besser.

Gegen PCN misst das erst das Live-Archiv.
